title: runners.local.toml header: note review/closeout are deliberately not overlaid
description:
Tick j6o records the blessed local claude exception at the review/closeout cells in .tick/runners.toml. The matching one-paragraph note in .tick/runners.local.toml's header (why it declares no review/closeout overlay) could not be written by a worker: runners.local.toml is outside the files a worker may write, and attempt 32 was rejected for exactly that edit. An operator or a run with that authority could add it; the guard test already enforces the behaviour, so this is documentation only.
evidence: .tick/runners.local.toml header; .ticfac/runs/epic-43y/decisions/40.json (boundary violation: .tick/runners.local.toml)
